literal: To weep having spoken, wrong having rebuked, proper way to know capable persons' friendship having examined take.
translation: Examine and accept the friendship of those capable of moving you to tears with their words, rebuking your wrongdoings, and guiding you to the proper path.
modern: தவறு செய்யும் போது மனம் வருந்தி அழும்படி அறிவுரை கூறியும், தீய வழியில் செல்லும்போது கண்டித்தும், நல்வழியை அறியச் செய்ய வல்லவர்களின் நட்பை ஆராய்ந்து ஏற்றுக்கொள்ள வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet defines the qualities of a true friend whose companionship is worth seeking. A good friend does not merely flatter but has the courage to speak harsh truths that might make one weep for their mistakes. They actively rebuke wrong actions and have the capacity to teach the proper path of conduct. The verse advises that one should carefully examine and secure the friendship of such capable individuals, as their guidance is invaluable.
